## Overview

This **2019-modified, 2026-09-15-captured** [[adyen]] MX925 manual page shows how to display terminal identifiers and network details on the device. It belongs to the historical **terminal-deprecation/MX925** manual; [[adyen-payment-terminals]] is the physical-device route. Displaying information is not a connectivity diagnostic, credential retrieval, current-support finding or payment-readiness proof. [Raw: lines 5–28]

## Key takeaways

- The page instructs the operator to press **5**, then the **button depicted by the confirm-button image**. The captured Markdown around the image has unusual escaping, so the raw image reference is the reliable button locator; do not infer further physical-key labels or menu permissions from this page. [Raw: lines 19–21]
- The display then lists **IP address**, **terminal ID**, and **software version**. It also shows a **QR code encoding** IP address, MAC address, network name, store name, merchant account name and terminal ID. These are device/account identifiers, not API credentials or evidence that those settings are valid or currently connected. [Raw: lines 23–28]
- The page provides no test result, endpoint reachability check, installed-version approval, account boarding confirmation or transaction outcome. Its 2019-modified MX925 path is historical model guidance. [Raw: lines 5–28]
